title: Connected Bits — Spot Workers and Spot Cloud
facts: Field task assignment, status updates, photo documentation and completion notes; supervisor filters by type, status, assignee and queue; CRM, GIS, asset and work-order integration.

title: Catalis Request311
facts: Request reassignment, updates and closure; complete request histories; map-based asset/parcels/boundaries; an available integration API.

title: Catalis — Public Works Efficiency with Citizen Request Management
facts: Crew routing, mobile viewing/updating/closing of requests, duplicate avoidance and equipment/material tracking.

title: Catalis — Inventory Tracking & Work Order Management
facts: Requests/jobs consume trucks, supplies, equipment and materials; work orders have scheduling, assignments and maintenance records; mapped assets retain GIS context.

title: Catalis GIS WebMap
facts: Smartphone field asset collection and condition assessment; integrations include ESRI, QGIS and municipal source datasets.
